title: Recap: Boston College falters in Cincinnati, loses 34-15

sources.title: Recap: Boston College falters in Cincinnati, loses 34-15
sources.description: On Saturday afternoon, Boston College opened the 2026 season against Cincinnati. After a 2-10 year, BC tore the roster down to the studs and reset, with the biggest new face being starting quarterback Mason McKenzie, a dangerous dual threat at Saginaw Valley State last season.
